page_title: NAN 2-0 HAV | Nantes v Le Havre 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' The ball is cleared after Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+1' Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jeremie Pignard ignores the protests.
90+1' Loic Nego (Le Havre) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
85' Kenny Quetant (Le Havre) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
82' A yellow card for a tackle by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre). Jeremie Pignard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
81' A substitution has been made. Louis Leroux goes off and Francis Coquelin (Nantes) comes on.
81' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper.
80' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) will take a corner kick.
79' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Le Havre win a corner.
78' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) has tested the patience of referee Jeremie Pignard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' The match can continue after the interruption.
74' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
73' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

70' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
67' Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) for a tough tackle.
63' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Ali Youssef (Nantes), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
63' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Sofiane Boufal will be replaced by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
62' It's time for a substitution. Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre) comes on in place of Yanis Zouaoui.
61' The foul by Issa Soumare (Le Havre) was seen by Jeremie Pignard who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

60' Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Mory Diaw pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
58' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
56' The corner from Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) is intercepted by the defence.

55' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Nantes force their opponents to concede a corner.
55' Nantes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

54' Louis Leroux (Nantes) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nantes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' Ahmed Kantari is forced to make a change. Ignatius Ganago is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes).
52' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mory Diaw, who smothers the ball.
50' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
48' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
46' Here is a change. Timothee Pembele is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Ally Samatta (Le Havre).
46' Ahmed Kantari prepares a substitution. Deiver Machado is replaced by Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes).
46' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Fode Doucoure as he is replaced by Kenny Quetant (Le Havre).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' A pass by Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
44' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) picks up a long through ball, but Mory Diaw deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
42' Le Havre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
38' Nantes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

37' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nantes.
35' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
34' 2 - 0 GOAL! Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Mory Diaw.
34' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
33' The Nantes players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

33' Play continues despite the shouts by some Nantes players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Jeremie Pignard interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
32' Lucas Gourna-Douath (Le Havre) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
29' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
27' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
26' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
24' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
22' Loic Nego (Le Havre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
20' Fabien Centonze (Nantes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
19' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
17' Le Havre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
17' A pass from Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) is intercepted by Anthony Lopes and the move breaks down. Le Havre have a corner.
15' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
14' Fabien Centonze (Nantes) sees a yellow card from Jeremie Pignard after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
12' Flag goes up against Issa Soumare (Le Havre) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
11' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
10' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.
9' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Nantes force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' A cross into the box from Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is cleared.
8' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
6' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Le Havre.
3' 1 - 0 Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) was unlucky to score an own goal attempting to intercept a cross. Hang your head in shame!
1' Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Nantes will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jeremie Pignard.
